text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: "Man is a mystery. It must be unraveled, and if it takes a whole lifetime,"

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: "don't say that it's a waste of time. I am occupied by this mystery because I want to be a human being."

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: — Fyodor Dostoevsky (Letter to Mikhail Dostoevsky, 16 August 1839)
